docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The last foray in Lithuania: the feud of two noble houses, a love across it and the Napoleonic wars on the horizon, in the great epic of Polish literature.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Adam Mickiewicz (1798–1855), Pan Tadeusz (Polish), 1834, translated by Maude Ashurst Biggs (1856–1933) as Master Thaddeus, 1885, with an introduction by W. R. Morfill (1834–1909) and notes by Edmund Naganowski (1853–1915). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from the Internet Archive. Modified: converted to this format.
